$ degenbot --help
Perform cli.

Usage: degenbot [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  database  Database commands
  exchange  Exchange commands
  pool      Pool commands
  aave      Aave commands
  fleet     Steer the live worker fleet over the operator command channel
  path      Steer a live bot over the operator command channel
  config    Inspect the operator config file and the values it resolves to
  strategy  Inspect the typed strategy facets (ADR-055)

Options:
      --database <PATH>      Path to the SQLite database (`--database` > `DEGENBOT_DB_PATH` > `<state_home>/degenbot/db/degenbot.db`)
      --chain-id <CHAIN_ID>  Session chain id (`--chain-id` > `DEGENBOT_DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID`)
      --node <URI>           Node RPC endpoint; the value's own scheme picks its transport (`wss://` > ws, `http://` > http, `ipc://` or a socket path > ipc). Repeat it to set one endpoint per transport. The explicit layer outranks the per-chain endpoint env families and the `nodes.*` file tables
      --config <PATH>        Typed config file the `strategy` verbs read and write (`--config` > `DEGENBOT_CONFIG` > the XDG config home)
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version
exit 0

$ degenbot --version
degenbot <semver> (build <receipt>)
exit 0

$ degenbot database inspect --database <head.db>
Schema state: legacy_alembic.
exit 0

$ degenbot database inspect --database <stale.db>
Schema state: legacy_alembic.
exit 0

$ degenbot exchange activate --chain base --name aerodrome_v2 (1st, fresh DB copy)
Activated Aerodrome V2 on Base (chain ID 8453).
exit 0

$ degenbot exchange activate --chain base --name aerodrome_v2 (2nd, idempotent)
Exchange is already activated.
exit 0

$ degenbot exchange deactivate --chain base --name aerodrome_v2 (1st)
Deactivated Aerodrome V2 on Base (chain ID 8453).
exit 0

$ degenbot exchange deactivate --chain base --name aerodrome_v2 (2nd, idempotent)
Exchange is already deactivated.
exit 0
